description: This script retrieves version information from a version file or associated version control system (git or hg) for a software project, primarily used in build or release processes.

methods.name: try_version
methods.description: Attempts to read the version directly from a 'version' file.

methods.name: try_git
methods.description: Attempts to determine the current revision from the git repository, supporting revisions specified as tags or branch names.

methods.name: try_hg
methods.description: Attempts to determine the current revision from an hg repository.
